claims.claim: TrafficAlign-generated scenarios reveal up to 10.8% more collisions on average across three autonomous driving models than state-of-the-art methods.
claims.metric: collision rate increase over best baseline
claims.condition: SafeBench; ego vehicles trained with PPO, SAC and TD3; six regional TrafficAlign instances (the region giving the maximum is not stated in packet); 40 initial scenarios, 50 search rounds each; strongest baseline ChatScene

claims.claim: Fine-tuning driving models with TrafficAlign-generated scenarios reduces collision rates by 36.1% compared with the original models.
claims.condition: PPO, SAC and TD3 driving models fine-tuned 500 epochs at learning rate 0.0001 on 48 scenarios, tested on a held-out composite set that pools the remaining 32 scenarios from each generation method; 36.1% is the upper end of a 21.0%-36.1% range across six regions, region not stated in packet
